Discover the Situation A2 · Week 11 · Lesson 2 · Asking for time off
Screen 1 of 5

Enter the scene

Mariam talks to her manager, Hana, in the office at the Cedar Community Centre. She wants to ask about time off.

What do you think Mariam is going to ask? Choose one idea, or just think about it.

Mariam is going to request a day off. She is asking politely and she is not sure the answer will be yes. Let’s listen.

Hear the situation

Listen to the short conversation. You can play it again as many times as you like.

Employee (Mariam)
Manager (Hana)
Employee
Could I take next Thursday off?
Manager
Who will cover your shift?
Employee
I’ll ask Amina. Would that be possible?
Manager
Let me check before I approve it.

Explore the leave calendar

This is the team calendar for one week at the Cedar Community Centre. Tap Thursday to see what happens to Mariam’s request.

Mon23 Nov
Tue24 Nov
Wed25 Nov
Fri27 Nov
Requested date: Thursday 26 Nov. Mariam asks for a day off.
Cover note: “Amina may cover my shift.” Mariam asks Amina first, because the work still needs to be done.
Manager’s reply: “I’m checking the plan.” The request is now a discussion. It is not approved yet.

Choose a step to see how a request becomes an arrangement.

A request starts a conversation. The manager checks the plan, and the day off is approved only after that. (All names and dates are a fictional teaching example.)
